- YTXTube: with the comments panel open the video controls work again (the panel starts under the picture, so only the other sheets, speed and quality, hide the controls).
- YTXTube: the mini player shows the whole picture (a SurfaceView ignores the scale of the open / close morph and showed the top left quarter, big; the picture now goes through a TextureView whenever the player is not resting fully open).
- Toolkit > Resolution: the screen resolution and the density scaled together as shares of the phone's own screen (3/4, 2/3, 5/8, 1/2, 3/8, 1/3, 1/4) or your own values; the density is counted from the phone's own density, so everything keeps its size on the screen; unconfirmed changes go back after 15 seconds (a guard process in the shell, the countdown in the app, and a check at the next opening). Needs root or Shizuku.
- Music, YouTube Music: a picked song no longer plays alone: the queue goes on with YouTube Music's own radio (RDAMVM automix) and is filled again whenever fewer than four songs are left, for as long as online songs play; every online song that plays is written to a history; the browse page opens on a 'For you' list (the radio of what was played lately and of your liked songs) with 'For you' and 'History' chips.
- Spotify: the connect page is on the screen where the music is browsed, with the steps (create the app, the redirect address with a copy button, add your account under User Management, paste the Client ID), the state, and a 'Test the connection' button that says who is logged in or why Spotify refuses (for example 403 for an account that is not added to the app); a list that comes back empty now says why.
- Files: archive menu without 'Extract here'; several archives -> each into its own folder (icon); Secure Folder off by default (setting); Copy path menu item removed, long-press on Copy copies paths.
- Game Hub CD View: progress bar and 'n / total' while covers are read. App asks for a large heap (fewer low-memory kills).
- Files from a browser opened with 'always Pulse': a file that is not an APK/bundle is handed on to the app that opens its kind instead of the install window ('not a readable file').
- Files: .torrent, .nfo and subtitle files open in the text viewer first, not the Android chooser.
- Keyboard: the suggestion bar shows about one word per 115 dp (landscape and low DPI show more), also at a sentence start.
- Keyboard: chemistry words (benzen -> benzene ring, formulas, element symbols) are offered on the bar like emoji.
- Keyboard: tapping the quoted (as typed) word puts it back with a space after it.
- Office: pinch zoom reads the current handler at each step (it kept the first lambda, so zoom jumped after the first pinch).
